exposure: ventilation modes (mechanical ventilation, nasal continuous positive airway pressure ventilation (NCPAP))
cohort: The study participants were all preterm infants admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) of Qilu Hospital, Shandong University (Qingdao) after obstetric delivery from January 2018 to December of 2021.
finding: Respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) in preterm infants is associated with various maternal and infant risk factors, a higher incidence of severe neonatal complications, and increased mortality.
mod_finding: Mothers of preterm infants with RDS had a higher rate of cesarean section compared to the non-RDS group.
birth_weight: Varied, with birth weight < 1500 g identified as an independent risk factor for RDS.
gest_age: Varied, with gestational age < 32 weeks identified as an independent risk factor for RDS.
